tasks.short: Establish an actual new computer account in the cage system

steps.what: Receive the actual account request and collect and capture the applicant's supplied identity and required account information
inputs: Actual applicant request and supplied documents
Existing cage account system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Actual captured application fields and source documents with missing information identified

steps.what: Verify the actual applicant, duplicates, required account authority and permitted account type under the existing process
inputs: Actual request and source information from s1
Existing account setup requirements and authoritative decisions where required
outputs: Human-verified actual account eligibility and selected permitted type, or a stopped request

steps.what: Fill exact verified applicant fields and the worker-selected account type into the native new-account draft
inputs: Actual source fields captured in s1 and verified selection from s2
outputs: Draft new computer account with exact source-linked fields

steps.what: Check the entire completed final account draft for identity, field accuracy, duplicates, account type and actual creation authority
inputs: Complete new-account draft from s3 and actual source evidence
outputs: Exact complete checked final account creation request, or an unresolved exception

steps.what: Commit the exact checked new computer account in the existing cage system
inputs: Exact complete account creation request checked in s4
outputs: Actually created computer account with actual status, or a failed creation result

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} new-account fields from actual applicant information captured and verified by the cage worker. Keep identity, account authority, duplicate checks and the complete final account check human before the separate creation commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual new account can require re-entering applicant fields already captured during the request.
tasks.enabler_now: Native account forms can reuse exact verified fields without deciding creditworthiness or account eligibility.
tasks.still_hard: Identity conflicts and the authority to establish a particular account need actual evidence and accountable decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Stop account creation when identity, authority or required information is unresolved.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native account forms can reuse exact captured identity fields while account eligibility and credit decisions remain distinct human responsibilities.

assumptions: This conditional account setup has actual manually repeated applicant fields. Shares are illustrative, not measured or based on the prompt prior.
The worker receives and captures actual source information in s1 and performs actual verification in s2. No free structured application, identity approval or credit authority is assumed.

This is computer account creation, not a model deciding house credit, credit limits or check-cashing authority. Where an authoritative approval is required, its existing production remains baseline and actual worker verification is counted; any new or transferred review labour must be added.
Try native forms first. Already prefilled account fields are baseline and earn no new gain. Missing or conflicting facts stop the draft for retained human resolution.

The completed final account request exists before s4 checking; changed fields or authority invalidate the gate. The same-system commit is negligible and earns no saving. No credential message, customer notification or financial transaction is silently sent.
unknowns: Actual account type, approval process and duplicate entry effort
research_questions: Which account fields are actually captured twice, and which existing authoritative decisions must precede account creation?

already_counted.description: Actual request capture, identity and authority verification and full final account check remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain account-field mappings and test duplicate, identity and authority exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete final account request checked in s4 for actual identity, type and creation authority; changes invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross saving=25 from actual repeated account fields. Deduct 3 incremental hours once for net 22. Account decisions and the negligible creation commit earn no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sell actual gambling chips, tokens or tickets and record the sale

steps.what: Receive the actual patron's purchase request and capture the selected denominations, quantities and tender method
inputs: Actual patron purchase request
Existing cage sales and payment system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Actual captured patron-selected purchase and tender information

steps.what: Verify actual patron and transaction requirements, tender acceptability and available chip, token or ticket stock under the existing cage process
inputs: Actual purchase and tender request from s1
Existing transaction requirements and physical stock
outputs: Actual verified request, tender route and available stock, or an unresolved exception

steps.what: Fill the exact already captured and verified purchase fields and totals into the native sale draft
inputs: Actual purchase fields captured in s1 and verified in s2
Existing explicit denomination values and total rule
outputs: Draft sale with exact requested items and calculated total

steps.what: Physically count and prepare the actual chips, tokens or tickets and check the entire final sale, tender amount, recipient and exact handover
inputs: Actual stock and sale draft from s3
Actual verified patron and request
outputs: Exact checked final sale and tender amount with physically counted purchase ready for this patron

steps.what: Receive and confirm the patron's actual authorised payment for the exact checked sale amount
inputs: Exact sale and tender amount checked in s4
Actual patron payment authorisation and tender
outputs: Actual confirmed payment or a failed or unresolved payment result

steps.what: Hand the exact checked and counted chips, tokens or tickets to the actual patron after confirmed payment
inputs: Exact purchase and patron checked in s4
Actual confirmed payment from s5
outputs: Actual purchased chips, tokens or tickets handed to the patron

steps.what: Complete and check the actual final sale record and receipt against the real payment and physical handover
inputs: Actual payment result from s5 and actual handover from s6
Existing sale draft
outputs: Exact complete checked actual sale record and matching receipt with actual status

steps.what: Commit the exact checked actual sale record
inputs: Exact final sale record checked in s7

steps.what: Issue the exact checked matching receipt to the actual patron
inputs: Exact final receipt checked in s7
outputs: Actual matching receipt delivered to the patron

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} reuse of an actual captured purchase into the sale draft, with explicit denomination totals. Keep transaction verification, physical counting, final sale checking, payment, chip handover, actual record checking, commit and receipt issue separately represented.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual sale can require repeating a captured purchase into the transaction draft.
tasks.enabler_now: Native cage sales fields can reuse exact verified item quantities and denomination values.
tasks.still_hard: The physical count, actual tender and patron eligibility cannot be replaced by a complete-looking sales draft.
tasks.human_edge: Reconcile what was requested, paid and physically handed over and stop on an exception.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native sales systems can reuse exact purchase fields and total denominations, while cash handling, physical chip transfer and actual transaction checks remain distinct work.

assumptions: This conditional patron sale has actual repeated entry after the purchase is captured. Shares are illustrative, not measured or derived from the supplied prior; an internal resale to another worker has a different recipient and action authority.

The cage worker obtains and captures every actual denomination, quantity and tender selection in s1 and verifies them in s2. No free structured purchase feed or customer eligibility approval is assumed.

Try native sales fields first. Existing totals, stock updates, receipt generation and payment runtime are baseline and earn no new gain. If capture already writes the sale directly, the proposed repeated-entry gain is zero.
The worker has ordinary authority for this transaction and retains actual required checks. Payment authorisation comes from the patron and is handled in s5; no chip handover occurs on failed payment.

The complete final sale exists before s4. Changed items, patron or amount invalidate its gates. Actual final record and receipt are completed and checked after the real payment and handover in s7, before their separate commit and issue.

The same-system commit is negligible and earns no saving; all real handoffs remain fully retained. If one native button performs multiple effects, the separate consequences retain their checks and do not create multiple savings.
unknowns: Actual repeated request entry and timing of native payment and receipt effects
research_questions: Observe one sale from request to actual chip handover and receipt to establish whether any duplicate entry exists.

already_counted.description: Actual request capture, transaction verification, physical preparation and full sale and final record checks remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain exact purchase-field mappings and test transaction and tender exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete sale and tender amount checked in s4, with actual patron payment authorisation; changed amount requires renewed checking.
Exact physically counted purchase and patron checked in s4, conditional on confirmed actual payment in s5; changes invalidate the check.
Exact final actual sale record checked in s7 after real payment and handover.
Exact matching final receipt checked in s7 against real payment and handover; changes invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85; gross saving=15 only if actual repeated sale entry exists. Deduct 2 incremental hours once for net 13. Existing totals and receipt generation, same-system commits and real payment and handover earn no new gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Native cage account and sale configuration
skills_to_grow: Trace every reused field to actual captured source information
Keep account authority separate from field entry
Reconcile actual payment, chip transfer and final records before actions
role.ambitious_version: A cage worker reduces verified duplicate entry while retaining identity and authority checks, physical control of value and complete actual transaction reconciliation.
